summary: Backend-only verification of the customer subscription invoice-PDF download fix. Created a maid subscription (svc-maid-fulltime, monthly) for Priya Verma (+919000000004), activated via /pay/mock, fetched invoice_id, then validated the authorised PDF endpoint contract. 5/5 pytest tests pass.
verified_behaviour: GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf as owner → 200, Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment; filename=*.pdf, body starts with %PDF magic bytes, size > 500 bytes
GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf with another customer's token (+919000000099) → 403 (no PDF body)
GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf with partner token (+919000000003) → 403 (no PDF body)
GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf with NO auth header → 401/403 (no PDF body)
Regression: GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id} as owner returns commission=3200, platform_fee=10, gst≈577.80, total≈8587.80 for monthly ₹8000 maid subscription
test_credentials: Owner: +919000000004 (Priya Verma); Other customer: +919000000099 (auto-created via create_if_new); Partner: +919000000003 (Raj Kumar); OTP 123456
seed_data_creation: Created 1 maid subscription + 1 activated transaction + 1 subscription invoice for +919000000004. Not cleaned up (invoice_id persists for retest convenience).
